Tool or resource page named by the toolkit

description: Web Soil Survey is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by USDA Natural Resources Conservation Service. Zoom in on a map and outline an area of interest to access a soil map and descriptions of soils for that location. Access additional information to determine the suitability of the soils for particular uses, or download data for further analysis in desktop tools. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Shifting Species, Habitats, and Ecosystems, Water Quality. Assets: Agriculture and Food Supply, Natural Areas and Wildlife, Urban Landscape and Tree Canopy. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
